crossRefs.note: “So let all your enemies perish, Yahweh, but let those who love him be as the sun when it rises in its strength.” Then…
He said, “If Yahweh doesn’t help you, where could I get help for you? From of the threshing floor, or from the wine…
Let God arise! Let his enemies be scattered! Let them who hate him also flee before him.
“Rejoice over her, O heaven, you saints, apostles, and prophets; for God has judged your judgment on her.”
In her was found the blood of prophets and of saints, and of all who have been slain on the earth.”

people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

translations.web: Samuel said, “Why then do you ask me, since Yahweh has departed from you and has become your adversary?
translations.bsb: “Why do you consult me,” asked Samuel, “since the LORD has turned away from you and become your enemy?
translations.kjv: Then said Samuel, Wherefore then dost thou ask of me, seeing the LORD is departed from thee, and is become thine enemy?
translations.asv: And Samuel said, Wherefore then dost thou ask of me, seeing Jehovah is departed from thee, and is become thine adversary?
